BibleLens: choose the styles to keep

TL;DR: Existing controls and cards vary in shape, size, spacing and feedback. Some differences carry useful meaning; others are styling drift. These boards show the discovered families together so you can keep one, several or all, and say where each belongs. Nothing here changes BibleLens.

16 groups · 144 source-component families · 26 comparison sheets · 1358 original variant records + 59 new gap captures.

D1–D3 retain the walkthrough topics. D4 onward adds the independent inventory. The old report.md has different decision numbers and is superseded for choosing styles by this page. No options are preselected.

Coverage boundary: all four loaded stylesheets were reviewed, including vendor map CSS. The original web matrix covers dark/light at 1280px and 375px with 100% text. Live additions were taken with the owner’s existing 115% text setting; it was preserved, not treated as drift. Full-card additions include both themes and widths where captured; some long blocks are viewport excerpts. This is not an installed-native review or a proof of every possible data/error state. Account-only sync actions, destructive note confirmation and retired hidden UI are source-reviewed, not falsely presented as live captures. Detailed coverage and source-only states.

Every group has comparison sheets plus an expandable gallery retaining every captured appearance. Thumbnail images can be reduced; original screenshots and measured CSS values are linked. Keep colors independently of shapes. P1/P2 compatibility does not imply a P2 redesign.

D1 Summary surfacesD2 Passage and citation controlsD3 Expanded evidence layoutsD4 Search and question-entry boxesD5 Quick filtersD6 Filter options in panelsD7 Related topics, people and placesD8 Dropdowns and value pickersD9 Tabs, switches and slidersD10 Expand and inspect controlsD11 Reset, apply and utility actionsD12 Navigation and icon actionsD13 Text fields and note editorsD14 Dialogs and panelsD15 Cards and content blocksD16 Keyboard focus cues

D1 — Summary surfaces

Choose summary treatment independently of the surrounding card. Read, Marked and Chat share glass but differ in spacing; the profile biography has no separate surface.
